Common Queries

Frequently Asked Questions

Get quick answers to the most common questions regarding engineering, medical, and general counseling rules.

What is the role of JB Siksha Institute in admissions?

We act as academic advisors and verification experts. We analyze your academic metrics, explain course contents, list appropriate colleges matching your marks, guide you on filling online preferences (ACPC/JoSAA/NEET), and verify compliance documents to avoid cancellation errors.

Do you charge extra fees for online counseling?

Our primary counseling sessions, university guides, and profile shortlistings are completely free of charge. For personalized end-to-end guidance, ACPC choice-filling management, and NRI-sponsored document compliance setups, we charge a nominal consulting fee, which will be explained transparently before you register.

How does ACPC choice filling advice work?

After GUJCET/JEE results are declared, the Admission Committee for Professional Courses (ACPC) in Gujarat opens choice-filling rounds. Our advisors help you build a priority list of branches and colleges. Placing choices in the wrong order can result in getting allotted to less preferred colleges despite having a higher rank. We help eliminate this risk.

Can you help with NRI quota and management seats?

Yes, we guide eligible candidates through the official channels for seats reserved under NRI (Non-Resident Indian), NRI-sponsored, and Management quotas. We verify the required sponsorships, relationships, and banking documents to make sure they meet NMC, AICTE, and State regulatory criteria.

What documents do I need to start the counseling session?

For a comprehensive assessment, please bring or upload copies of your Class 10 Marksheet, Class 12 Marksheet (if declared), Category Certificate (if applicable, e.g. SEBC/EWS/SC/ST, along with a valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate), and Entrance Scorecards (JEE/GUJCET/NEET).
